content.description: Illustration showing hands removing bolts from converter housing

items: (a) Remove the two 12-mm bolts and four 10-mm bolts.
(b) Hold the input shaft while removing the converter housing.

content.description: Illustration showing removal of speedometer drive gear with snap ring

items: (b) Remove the drive gear and the steel ball.

content.description: Illustration showing removal of sensor rotor, key and snap ring from output shaft

content.text: 10. REMOVE SENSOR ROTOR, KEY AND SNAP RING FROM OUTPUT SHAFT

content.description: Illustration showing removal of pan and gasket from transmission case

items: (b) Remove the pan by lifting the transmission case.

content.text: NOTE: Do not turn the transmission over as this will contaminate the valve body with foreign materials in the bottom of the pan.

content.description: Illustration showing hand using magnet to examine particles in transmission pan

content.text: Remove the magnet and use it to collect any steel chips. Look carefully at the chips and particles in the pan and on the magnet to anticipate what type of wear you will find in the transmission:
Steel (magnetic) = bearing, gear and clutch plate wear.
